1. A system comprising: one or more processors; and one or more memories including program code that is executable by the one or more processors to: execute a first processing operation on a dataset comprising a plurality of records and having a dependency hierarchy with a plurality of levels, each level of the dependency hierarchy comprising one or more records and having at least one lower level except a lowest level, wherein the first processing operation involves identifying a first set of records in the dataset that are independent from any other records in the dataset and storing the first set of records in a datastore, wherein the first set of records correspond to the lowest level of the dependency hierarchy, and
wherein the first processing operation further involves identifying a second set of records in the dataset that are dependent on other records in the dataset and storing the second set of records in a temporary memory that is different from the datastore; and
after completing the first processing operation, execute a second processing operation to process the second set of records stored in the temporary memory in accordance with an iterative hierarchical processing scheme, wherein each iteration of the iterative hierarchical processing scheme involves: identifying a subset of records in the temporary memory corresponding to a particular level of the dependency hierarchy; and for each record in the subset of records: obtaining one or more previously processed records on which the record depends, wherein the one or more previously processed records are associated with one or more lower levels of the dependency hierarchy, and wherein the one or more previously processed records were previously processed during the first processing operation or one or more previous iterations of the iterative hierarchical processing scheme; processing the record using the one or more previously processed records; storing the processed record in the datastore; and removing the record from the temporary memory.

2. The system of claim 1, wherein processing the record using the one or more previously processed records comprises: performing a validation operation involving determining whether the record and the one or more previously processed records satisfy one or more criteria.

3. The system of claim 2, wherein: each record of the one or more previously processed records includes a column; and the one or more criteria include a constraint on a value of the column for each record in the one or more previously processed records.
4. The system of claim 2, wherein: the one or more criteria include a constraint on a number of one or more previously processed records.
5. The system of claim 2, wherein a given record depends on one or more other records when the validation operation requires data from each of the one or more other records.

7. The system of claim 6, wherein: the first processing operation and the second processing operation are executed in relation to a database transaction; and the indication to store the first set of records and the second set of records in the database is an instruction to commit the database transaction.

8. The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more memories include additional program code that is executable by the one or more processors to: prior to executing the first processing operation: receive a file including the dataset; and generate a data stream including the plurality of records by processing the file to extract the plurality of records; and
wherein executing the first processing operation involves processing records received via the data stream.
9. The system of claim 8, wherein the file is a spreadsheet file, a comma-separated values (“CSV”) file, or a representation of a database table.

10. The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more memories include additional program code that is executable by the one or more processors to: receive an indication of a maximum number of records that are dependent on one or more other records to process during an iteration of the iterative hierarchical processing scheme; and wherein: each iteration of the iterative hierarchical processing scheme further involves identifying a plurality of subsets of records, wherein each subset of the plurality of subsets of records has a number of records less than or equal to the maximum number of records.
